illustration_style: Two layers: lightly illustrated branding with botanical ornaments and serif typography; the crochet product rendered as realistic high-end yarn crochet product photography.
line_weight: Branding ornaments and dividers only, never the crochet product: No drawn outlines
line_quality: Branding ornaments and dividers only, never the crochet product: Not applicable; definition comes from clearly resolved yarn loops, stitch relief and softly irregular handmade contours.
detail_level: Crochet construction must remain legible at Etsy thumbnail size. Branding ornaments should remain sparse and fine.
character_language: When character motifs are used, render them as original compact crochet figures with rounded proportions, simple attached facial details and friendly restrained expressions.
background_density: Low to medium; clean tactile studio surfaces with a few understated seasonal texture cues, kept secondary to the crochet work.
composition: Clear single-product or small coordinated-group hierarchy, ample peripheral breathing room for optional pattern-cover titling, and uncluttered edges suitable for thumbnails.
palette: Autumnal earth tones of terracotta, ochre, moss, mulberry and warm cream, grounded with oatmeal and soft stone neutrals; use a small cool accent only where it improves colour separation.
shading: Product: soft natural directional light, realistic contact shadows and dimensional depth. Branding ornaments: soft and flat.
texture: Product: visible yarn fibres, crochet loops, stitches and small handmade irregularities. Background: subtle cream linen weave.
mood: Cosy, tactile, polished and quietly abundant; adult craft-market warmth with a modern seasonal feel.
print_considerations: Use pale or lightly textured backgrounds, preserve fine stitch contrast at home-print scale, avoid large solid dark fields, and keep any cover text high-contrast and well clear of trimming or folding zones.
shared_prompt: Premium crochet pattern collection: Two layers: lightly illustrated branding with botanical ornaments and serif typography; the crochet product rendered as realistic high-end yarn crochet product photography. Product: visible yarn fibres, crochet loops, stitches and small handmade irregularities. Background: subtle cream linen weave.
avoid: Any exact pumpkin forms, stitch construction, stems, colour assignments or diagonal flat-lay from the references
Any woven-basket flower arrangement, stitched badge, label text or source typography from the references
Any held dark-wrapped spooky bouquet, white bow, figure pose or leaf-framed brown backdrop from the references
Large ink-heavy black or charcoal background fields
Cluttered props that obscure construction details
Misspelled text, faux brand marks, logos or copied promotional wording
Stitch diagrams, charts or written instructions inside the artwork
feedback_applied: Restyle: realistic crochet product, illustrated branding only (ADR-043).
